1: // Canvas Asteroid Dodge – concise implementation
2: // The HTML includes <canvas id="game"></canvas>
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return; // safety
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const W = canvas.width;
9:   const H = canvas.height;
10: 
11:   // Ship definition
12:   const ship = {
13:     w: 40,
14:     h: 20,
15:     x: W / 2 - 20,
16:     y: H - 30,
17:     speed: 5,
18:     dir: 0, // -1 left, 1 right
19:   };
20: 
21:   // Asteroid pool
22:   const asteroids = [];
23:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1000; // ms
24:   let lastSpawn = 0;
25: 
26:   let score = 0;
27:   let gameOver = false;
28: 
29:   // Input handling
30:   const keys = {};
31:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
32:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = true;
33:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = true;
34:   });
35:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
36:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = false;
37:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = false;
38:   });
39: 
40:   function spawnAsteroid() {
41:     const radius = 10 + Math.random() * 15;
42:     const x = Math.random() * (W - radius * 2) + radius;
43:     const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 3;
44:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -radius, r: radius, speed });
45:   }
46: 
47:   function update(dt) {
48:     if (gameOver) return;
49: 
50:     // Move ship
51:     ship.dir = 0;
52:     if (keys.left) ship.dir = -1;
53:     if (keys.right) ship.dir = 1;
54:     ship.x += ship.dir * ship.speed;
55:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - ship.w, ship.x));
56: 
57:     // Spawn asteroids
58:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
59:       spawnAsteroid();
60:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
61:     }
62: 
63:     // Update asteroids
64:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
65:       const a = asteroids[i];
66:       a.y += a.speed;
67:       // Collision detection (simple circle‑rect)
68:       if (
69:         a.y + a.r > ship.y &&
70:         a.x > ship.x &&
71:         a.x < ship.x + ship.w
72:       ) {
73:         gameOver = true;
74:         break;
75:       }
76:       // Remove off‑screen
77:       if (a.y - a.r > H) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
78:     }
79: 
80:     // Increment score (per frame)
81:     score++;
82:   }
83: 
84:   function draw() {
85:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
86: 
87:     // Ship
88:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
89:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, ship.h);
90: 
91:     // Asteroids
92:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a00';
93:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
94:       ctx.beginPath();
95:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
96:       ctx.fill();
97:     });
98: 
99:     // Score
100:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
101:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
102:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score / 60), 10, 20);
103: 
104:     // Game over overlay
105:     if (gameOver) {
106:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
107:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
108:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
109:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
110:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
111:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
112:     }
113:   }
114: 
115:   let lastTime = 0;
116:   function loop(timestamp) {
117:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
118:     lastTime = timestamp;
119:     update(dt);
120:     draw();
121:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
122:   }
123:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
124: })();
